arXiv:2609.27306v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Conventional score-based diffusion models learn scores without representing normalized densities, whereas tractable normalized models support both sampling and direct likelihood evaluation. Explicit Markov jump operators govern the forward noising and reverse denoising dynamics, extending discrete diffusion models with normalized distributions to spin systems on higher-dimensional lattices. arXiv:2605.20031v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The design of physics-augmented neural networks (PANNs) for the purposes of constitutive modeling has received considerable attention as of late for a variety of material behaviors. The resulting elastic law obeys the physically reasonable Legendre-Hadamard (or ellipticity) condition as well as the notion of increasing stress with increasing strain. arXiv:2609.28120v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a class of 2d quantum spin systems based on a unitary spherical fusion category with a chosen object.
